description: This script is a test suite for verifying Git's handling of internationalization and commit encoding settings when interacting with Subversion repositories. It performs setup, commit, and dcommit operations across multiple encodings, validating that commit encodings are respected according to configuration.

methods.name: compare_git_head_with
methods.description: Compares the current git head commit message with the reference file to ensure consistency.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Prepares the environment by setting the locale to UTF-8.

methods.name: compare_svn_head_with
methods.description: Compares the SVN log message with the reference file to verify encoding handling.
